remarks: Very rare and amazing opportunity to build your dream home on a large cleared lot in the centre of St. Albert. This small culdesac is hidden behind large mature trees in the community of Grandin with only one entrance and no through road. All the homes and lots in this special pocket are larger in size and each have their own unique curb appeal.  This property offers the unmatched opportunity of being tucked away out of sight to passers by, A quiet and serene feel and just a short walk to City center to take in the various restaurants,shopping outlets and the well known farmers market during the summer months.   The plot dimensions in metric are as follows. Front:  19.97 Rear:   18.77 North P/L: 61.46 South P/L: 52.01 (id:67522)
